title: 阻止--limit之外的委派写入，分别校验源主机和执行目标
body:
## 操作环境
平台隔离Linux普通用户、ansible-core与Python3/PyYAML。本题仅使用临时目录和本地原生命令，缺依赖待验收，不要求学员搭服务器。

## 操作任务
修复playbook.yaml：--limit仅限制play的原始主机，不会自动批准delegate_to目标。任何写入前，从只读policy.json核对原始inventory_hostname、明确委派目标和目标hostvars.environment；外部extra-vars中的trusted_policy/approved_targets不能替代该批准来源。通过后在独立delegate目录写release.json，分别记录origin、delegate及hostvars[delegate_target].ansible_host中的明确委派地址。验收原生local连接的6组场景，正常幂等；生产/未知/错误源/目标归属变化/伪批准输入均失败且没有任何delegate目录。所有主机别名都使用本地连接，文档地址仅作身份字段，不连接真实服务器；此题修复的根因是delegate_to越过limit的执行边界，不重复旧题冒号并集错误。

## 产物
- playbook.yaml：完整可执行配置或程序。

只修改以上文件，其他材料只读。

## 验收方法
可信验收实际执行Ansible原生命令，检查正常、错误、变化输入与文件副作用；文字描述或静态标签不能代替运行结果。所有目标只限题目临时范围，不访问业务服务器。
answer:
### playbook.yaml
```yaml
- name: Enforce origin and delegated execution scope
  hosts: web
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  any_errors_fatal: true
  tasks:
    - name: Check the independent approval and both identities
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - inventory_hostname in (lookup('ansible.builtin.file', playbook_dir ~ '/policy.json') | from_json).source_hosts
          - delegate_target in (lookup('ansible.builtin.file', playbook_dir ~ '/policy.json') | from_json).delegates
          - delegate_target in hostvars
          - hostvars[delegate_target].environment == (lookup('ansible.builtin.file', playbook_dir ~ '/policy.json') | from_json).environment
    - name: Create only the approved delegate artifact directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: '{{ workspace }}/delegates/{{ delegate_target }}'
        state: directory
        mode: '0700'
      delegate_to: '{{ delegate_target }}'
    - name: Record origin and execution target independently
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: '{{ workspace }}/delegates/{{ delegate_target }}/release.json'
        content: '{{ {"origin": inventory_hostname, "delegate": delegate_target, "execution_address": hostvars[delegate_target].ansible_host, "release": release_label} | to_json }}'
        mode: '0600'
      delegate_to: '{{ delegate_target }}'

```

import pathlib,hashlib
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
FIXED={'policy.json': '25ec108927a08edc0fc28a3c592b556d83986d8fd89538f1af4f4bf5c389f980'}
for name,digest in FIXED.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((BASE/name).read_text(encoding='utf8').encode()).hexdigest()==digest,'readonly fixture changed'
import json,os,sys,subprocess,tempfile,copy,re
import yaml
source=(BASE/"playbook.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf8")
doc=yaml.safe_load(source)
assert len(doc)==1 and doc[0]["hosts"]=="web" and doc[0].get("connection")=="local" and not doc[0].get("become",False)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ansible-delegate-approval-") as tmp:
 base=pathlib.Path(tmp)
 for case,target,origin,scope,expected in [
  ("approved","control-test","web-a","test",True),
  ("prod-delegate","control-prod","web-a","test",False),
  ("unknown","missing","web-a","test",False),
  ("wrong-origin","control-test","web-b","test",False),
  ("scope-drift","control-test","web-a","production",False),
  ("approved-override-attempt","control-prod","web-a","test",False)
 ]:
  root=base/case;root.mkdir()
  (root/"playbook.yaml").write_text(source,encoding="utf8")
  (root/"policy.json").write_text((BASE/"policy.json").read_text(encoding="utf8"),encoding="utf8")
  inv={"all":{"children":{"web":{"hosts":{"web-a":{"ansible_host":"192.0.2.11","environment":"test"},"web-b":{"ansible_host":"192.0.2.12","environment":"test"}}},"controllers":{"hosts":{"control-test":{"ansible_host":"192.0.2.21","environment":scope},"control-prod":{"ansible_host":"192.0.2.22","environment":"production"}}}},"vars":{"ansible_connection":"local"}}}

  if case=="approved-override-attempt":values.update(trusted_policy={"source_hosts":["web-a"],"delegates":["control-prod"],"environment":"production"},approved_targets=["control-prod"])
  (root/"input.json").write_text(json.dumps(values),encoding="utf8")
  (root/"ansible.cfg").write_text("[defaults]\nretry_files_enabled=False\n[inventory]\nenable_plugins=yaml\n",encoding="utf8")
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("ANSIBLE_")}
  env.update(ANSIBLE_CONFIG=str(root/"ansible.cfg"),ANSIBLE_FORKS="1",ANSIBLE_NOCOLOR="1",ANSIBLE_LOCAL_TEMP=str(root/"control_tmp"),ANSIBLE_REMOTE_TEMP=str(root/"remote_tmp"))
  args=["ansible-playbook","-i","inventory.yml","playbook.yaml","--limit",origin,"-f","1","-e","@input.json"]
  p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
  if not expected:
   assert p.returncode!=0,"delegation escaped independent approval"
   assert not (root/"delegates").exists(),"scope failure must precede any write"
  else:
   assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
   actual=json.loads((root/"delegates/control-test/release.json").read_text(encoding="utf8"))
   assert actual=={"origin":"web-a","delegate":"control-test","execution_address":"192.0.2.21","release":"release-B"}
   again=subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
   assert again.returncode==0 and re.search(r"changed=0\b",again.stdout.rsplit("PLAY RECAP",1)[-1])

title: 修复共享listen主题误激活无关组件，并在写入前验证整组候选

import hashlib,json,pathlib,sqlite3,sys
from urllib.parse import quote
def validate(db_path,manifest_path):
    path=pathlib.Path(db_path)
    if not path.is_file() or path.is_symlink():raise ValueError("regular standalone snapshot required")
    if any(pathlib.Path(str(path)+suffix).exists() for suffix in ["-wal","-shm","-journal"]):raise ValueError("snapshot has unhandled sidecars")
    expected=json.loads(pathlib.Path(manifest_path).read_text(encoding="utf8"))
    before=path.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()!=expected["sha256"]:raise ValueError("snapshot checksum mismatch")
    with sqlite3.connect("file:"+quote(str(path.resolve()))+"?mode=ro",uri=True) as db:
        if db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchall()!=[("ok",)]:raise ValueError("integrity failed")
        if db.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall():raise ValueError("orphaned order")
        if db.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0]!=expected["version"]:raise ValueError("schema version mismatch")
        tables={r[0] for r in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'")}
        if tables!={"customers","orders"}:raise ValueError("unexpected schema")
        customer_ids=[r[0] for r in db.execute("SELECT id FROM customers ORDER BY id")]
        order_ids=[r[0] for r in db.execute("SELECT id FROM orders ORDER BY id")]
        if customer_ids!=expected["customer_ids"] or order_ids!=expected["order_ids"]:raise ValueError("business rows missing or extra")
        if db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE typeof(cents)!='integer' OR cents<0").fetchone()[0]:raise ValueError("invalid order amount")
        total=db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cents),0) FROM orders").fetchone()[0]
        if total!=expected["total_cents"]:raise ValueError("business aggregate mismatch")
        result={"valid":True,"customers":len(customer_ids),"orders":len(order_ids),"total_cents":total}
    if path.read_bytes()!=before:raise ValueError("validator mutated snapshot")
    return result
if __name__=="__main__":print(json.dumps(validate(sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]),sort_keys=True))

平台隔离Linux普通用户、ansible-core与Python3/PyYAML。本题仅使用临时目录和本地原生命令，缺依赖待验收，不要求学员搭服务器。
